behavior.failure: Command-squad destruction publishes deterministic Defeat and CampaignOperations return without mutating loss facts or applying a retry penalty.
behavior.retry: Accepted relaunch preserves session and deterministic seed, increments the caller-owned attempt identity, removes prior mission-role entities, clears prior launch/action/settlement results and requests, resets result/facts, and cannot duplicate rewards, events, or entities.
behavior.unload: Mission system teardown destroys remaining mission-role entities and idempotently disposes only an owned catalog blob.

validation.incidentalUnityOutputs: Seven known validator outputs restored exactly to entry head
